It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Display the last part of a file of any extension.

file_name.description: The name of the file to display. No path is allowed and you can only perform on file at local directory.

lines.description: The number of lines to display from the end of the file. Defaults to 10.

last_lines.description: The last part of the file.

1. 使用 `du` 工具取得目前工作目錄下所有檔案、子目錄之磁碟空間占用量。
2. 將結果轉換成純粹由數位組成，後隨單字 **“bytes”** 的格式，例如 `205 bytes`。
3. 建立名為 `usage.txt` 的新檔案，並寫入上述文字。

現在你可以透過 `cat usage.txt` 或者直接打開它來驗證內容。祝順利！
